feeds.title: Bargain Books Blog
feeds.description: With range, Bargain Books strive to make a broad spectrum of books available, ensuring that popular authors and current bestsellers are on display along with books of specific local interest and hidden gems. Established in 1998, Bargain Books is South Africa's leading discount book retailer with 82 stores in all 9 provinces.

feeds.title: Modjaji Books Blog
feeds.description: Modjaji Books is an independent feminist press that publishes southern African women writers. We publish short stories, novels, memoirs, biography, poetry, essays, narrative non-fiction, reference books, and relevant non-fiction.

feeds.title: The Book Tree Blog
feeds.description: A blog about children's books, literacy and reading skills, creativity and writing. We believe all children should have access to books! The Book Tree is on a mission to excite children about reading, to help parents on this path and to get books into the hands of children throughout our country.

feeds.title: The Books Page
feeds.description: This site is the work of Vivien Horler, former Books Editor of the Cape Argus in Cape Town.

feeds.title: Literary Inspired
feeds.description: Literary Inspired is a romance book blog dedicated to celebrating the enchanting world of love stories. Immerse yourself in a sea of diverse romance sub-genres, including rom-coms, dark romance, smut, fantasy, sci-fi and paranormal romance, mafia romance, MC romance, sports romance, and more. Join me on this passionate journey as we support indie authors, share in-depth book reviews, and uncover hidden gems that will capture your heart. Discover your next great romance read and fall in love with the magic of words.

feeds.title: Book Village Blog
feeds.description: 78% of children cannot read for meaning by the end of Grade 4. We are on a mission to change that!We have noticed that there is a distressing lack of human connection in the learning to read process in low-income schools throughout South Africa. Classrooms are overcrowded, under-resourced and teachers overextended. Through providing low-income schools with digital infrastructure, our online tutoring application, and a digital library we intend to help these children learn to read for meaning and enjoyment.

feeds.title: All The Books and I
feeds.description: My name is Chevonn Kwakye-Agyekum. I live in Johannesburg in South Africa. I have a variety of interests and hobbies which include exercise, playing guitar, studying (I'm currently doing a BCom), and reading obviously! I aim to write book reviews that are helpful and informative in order for you to be able to find books you would enjoy reading.

feeds.title: The Book Lounge Blog
feeds.description: The Book Lounge is an independent book store in the heart of cape town. The website features its best books and helps you build a TBR from its recommended book list.

feeds.title: Wordsworth Books Blog
feeds.description: Follow Wordsworth Books and find your next best read. The book shop with a mind of its own. Our staff is knowledgeable and passionate and we aim for excellent service.

feeds.title: EW Blog
feeds.description: EW BLOG is a reading and writing hub, where we play with words. We review books from local authors, Afrika's best and international authors. We also discuss current political matters without sounding bias.

feeds.title: Preflight Books Blog
feeds.description: Preflight Books is perfectly positioned to provide established publishers, aspiring authors, self-publishers, and corporate clients the services they need to bring their manuscripts to life. We offer editorial services such as editing, proofreading, and writing, design services such as layout and illustration, printing and marketing services, workshops, and much, much more.

feeds.title: Sunday Times » Books
feeds.description: The following section of Sunday Times is dedicated to Book, featuring articles on the latest release, best book, author interview, and more. The Sunday Times is South Africa's biggest Sunday newspaper.
